about: Script for --fake (src/fake-driver.ts) over the states fixture: one session per wired state of requirements R8.2. Made up. `at` is ms after the backend starts, `ago` how long the status has been going; `retry.in` is ms until the retry goes. f6f6… has no step: its main turn is over and its background subagents run, so it reads working (R8.2).Run: app/dev.sh --fake --claude-dir app/backend/test/fixtures/claude-states, or app/web/dev/cdp/run.sh states.
